words.sense: brief yet clear, supplying necessary information without filler
misconceptions: Assuming every short message is rude.
Assuming a clear message cannot be brusque.

words.sense: extremely brief in a way that sounds abrupt or unfriendly
misconceptions: Assuming every short message is rude.
Assuming a clear message cannot be brusque.

edges.boundary_rule: Concise communication says enough clearly in few words; terse communication is so abrupt that its brevity feels curt.
